query: WITH a AS (SELECT distinct_id,argMin(properties.experiment_variant,timestamp) v,min(timestamp) t FROM events WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-09-15 19:27:22','UTC') AND timestamp < toDateTime('2026-10-06 12:04:08','UTC') AND properties.$host IN ('gainframe.app','www.gainframe.app') AND properties.experiment_id='body_visualizer_cta_v1' AND properties.experiment_phase='four_treatments_v1' AND coalesce(properties.experiment_forced,false)=false AND properties.platform IN ('ios','desktop') AND event='tool_cta_assigned' GROUP BY distinct_id HAVING uniq(properties.experiment_variant)=1), c AS (SELECT distinct_id,properties.experiment_variant v,min(timestamp) t FROM events WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-09-15 19:27:22','UTC') AND timestamp < toDateTime('2026-10-06 12:04:08','UTC') AND properties.$host IN ('gainframe.app','www.gainframe.app') AND properties.experiment_id='body_visualizer_cta_v1' AND properties.experiment_phase='four_treatments_v1' AND coalesce(properties.experiment_forced,false)=false AND properties.platform IN ('ios','desktop') AND event='tool_cta_clicked' GROUP BY distinct_id,v) SELECT a.v,count() assigned,uniqIf(a.distinct_id,c.t>=a.t AND c.distinct_id!='') clickers FROM a LEFT JOIN c ON a.distinct_id=c.distinct_id AND a.v=c.v GROUP BY a.v LIMIT 4
